conditions.evidence: ambulatory patients with chronic heart failure
conditions.label: chronic heart failure

conditions.evidence: risk predictors of cardiac mortality and sudden cardiac death
conditions.label: sudden cardiac death

modalities.evidence: blood laboratory parameters performed at enrolment

output.population: 992 patients with CHF consecutively enrolled from specialized HF clinics of eight University Spanish Hospitals, enrolled April 2003 to December 2004
output.summary: Prospective multicentre longitudinal study of ambulatory chronic heart failure patients, with resting and Holter ECG, chest X-ray, echocardiography and blood laboratory data at enrolment, following cardiac death and sudden cardiac death outcomes.
